title: Remembering the back alley brawls of The Warriors, a Rockstar city game that isn't an open world
description: The older I get, the more fascinated I somehow become by how videogames depict night, how particular technologies at particular times give rise to particular nightlives. I've already gushed about the Starlight Zone in Sonic the Hedgehog – the mild dissociation incubated by the soft, ceaseless glare of the construction yard, the eyeless brick at the level's nadir, the sleepless glitter of the skyline. Now, let me wind the clock forward, and backward, to Rockstar Toronto's The Warriors. One long night from the late '70s, sweaty and electric and menacing, fed through dank and sullen polygons from 2005. Probably the best move Rockstar made with their adaptation of Walter Hill's film is to retain the element of phantasmagoria. Both the game and the movie open with a view of Coney Island's Wonder Wheel, its neon lamps forming a floating tracery of Morse code, cabins swinging almost imperceptibly against solid darkness. This is a kind of night in which light is more emblem than illumination, refusing to travel far, clinging to its source like a frightened ghost. Read more

title: GTA 6’s Digital Release Has GameStop CEO Defending Physical Games, For Obvious Reasons
description: The GTA 6 launch looks set to break several records, as the digital-only game appears on track to be a major critical and commercial hit. Right on cue, GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen has criticized publishers that forgo a traditional physical release as a business strategy that hurts consumers and GameStop's bottom line, without explicitly mentioning GTA 6 publisher Take-Two Interactive. "When you buy a game, you should be able to sell it, trade it, or lend it to a friend," Cohen said to Bloomberg. "Unquestionably, the decision to move to all-digital has hurt consumers, and it's also hurt GameStop. Of course they don't like [trade-ins] because removing a used copy eliminates an alternative to buying new. They're taking away competition." Cohen's comments come in the wake of GTA 6 being a digital-only release--the "physical" edition includes a download code for it. It's also somewhat ironic for Cohen to defend physical games, given the GameStop boss's July remarks that physical video games were "irrelevant" to GameStop's business strategy. That business model has relied heavily on secondhand game sales, and none of those profits ever made their way back to the original publishers. Currently, GameStop says that selling video game software makes up the smallest part of its business. But in the case of GTA 6? Going digital probably made financial sense for Take-Two Interactive and developer Rockstar Games. The entire game clocks in at over 211GB, which means three standard 100GB Ultra HD Blu-ray discs would have been needed to house GTA 6 in its launch-day entirety--although realistically, Take-Two probably would have opted for one disc and forced consumers to download the rest of the game. That would have raised costs, and it wouldn't be unlikely to imagine Take-Two fearing the discs being reverse-engineered for secrets ahead of GTA 6's launch. Going digital essentially removed those risks, and while PlayStation and Xbox do take a cut of profits for hosting the game on their…

title: Despite The Pricing Hellscape, Console Sales Grew In October
description: Video game consoles are more expensive than ever, but sales are growing regardless, at least in the US. Circana has released its report for US video game industry sales in October, confirming that PS5 unit sales increased by 5% compared to October 2025. That's despite the average selling price of a PS5 increasing by 13%. Xbox Series X|S unit sales jumped by 10% in October 2026 compared to October 2025, and the average selling price rose by 29% year-over-year. The Switch 2 was October 2026's top console in unit and dollar sales, and it remains 2026's best-performing console by those measurements, followed by PS5. However, Circana did not break out the specifics for Switch 2 unit sales or average selling price changes. Total hardware spending in the US on game consoles was up by 2%, reaching $357 million. Higher pricing drove the dollar sales growth, Circana said, noting that PS5 dollar sales rose by 20% and Xbox Series X|S jumped by 42%. However, Switch 2 sales, measured by dollar sales, fell by 11%. Looking back to September 2026, PS5 hardware dollar sales grew by 43%, while spending on Xbox Series X|S dropped by 2% and Switch 2 fell by 12%. It will be interesting to see the November US hardware data when it comes in, as experts have said the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S could get a jolt in sales from people buying systems to play GTA 6. However, Circana has warned that sales might not be as strong as expected due to the increased prices. Microsoft, Sony, and Nintendo have raised prices on their consoles due in part to the ongoing memory and component shortages from the AI buildout. Tariffs have also played a role. On the subject of tariffs, all three received refunds from the government after the Supreme Court deemed the tariffs illegal, but those companies are keeping the money and not giving anything back to you. The companies argued that people who paid more knew what they were doing and don't deserve to get any money back.

title: GTA 6’s Mandy Could Be Hiding A Killer Secret
description: One of the first characters you meet in the opening chapter of Rockstar's GTA 6 is Mandy, and people online are thirsting hard for her. However, fans have also discovered evidence that they believe points to Mandy being a serial killer. While Jason is fixing Mandy's sink, he discovers an object--a severed finger--was the cause of the blockage. Mandy snaps it away from him quickly, presumably to hide the evidence. Players who stick around after fixing the sink to explore Mandy's place found other clues that point to Mandy being a killer. Jason can find a meat cleaver and tape in the trunk of her car, and items someone like Dexter Morgan might use to get rid of a body--acid and saws--can be found in her yard. Beyond all of this, a newly dug grave can be seen next to Mandy's home. Could there be another explanation here? Of course, but the signs are pointing to Mandy not being all that she seems. If you can look past Mandy's possible shadiness, you might be wondering if you're able to romance her in GTA 6. Mandy is clearly trying to flirt with Jason, but he's having none of it--the game does not allow players to romance her. In fact, Mandy doesn't show up again as a character you can interact with at all. if you want to find out about actual romance options in GTA 6 and how to get Jason and Lucia together, take a look at our other guide. We’ve also covered whether Jason and Lucia can go on dates together if you’re in the mood for some more romance.

title: PlayStation Plus Is Losing More Games, But One Departure Stings The Most
description: New arrivals are landing in the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog this month, but at the same time, you can also expect a few departures from that gaming library. Fortunately, the number of games leaving soon are on the smaller side, as there'll be only three exits in total. Unfortunately, one of those games that you're running out of time to play through the Game Catalog is a massive and pretty fun fantasy title, so get those hours in while you can. PlayStation Plus Game Catalog games leaving soon Granblue Fantasy Relink Granblue Fantasy Relink Somerville Fade to Silence This month's biggest departure is Granblue Fantasy Relink, a massive fantasy game with a storybook art style, cinematic boss fights, and a large roster of characters who all possess unique abilities to master. First released in February 2024, Granblue Fantasy Relink is built around real-time combat and flashy team-up mechanics, making for a visually striking experience overall. While the story isn't much to write home about, it's the gameplay and worldbuilding where this Granblue spin-off shines, and it got even better earlier this year with the Endless Ragnarok expansion. In comparison, Somerville is a story-rich puzzle game that's oozing atmosphere with its slick art direction, and Fade to Silence is a single-player and co-op survival-crafting adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world that is feeling the chill of an eternal winter. While the Game Catalog is going to be a little poorer without those three titles, it is getting some great games this month. Death Stranding 2: On the Beach is the headline act, and it'll be joined by several more titles like Atomfall, Dragon Quest 3 HD-2D Remake, and Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii. All PlayStation Plus subscribers can also grab a trio of freebies between now and November 30: Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider 4-6 Remastered, and Monster Train 2.

title: How To Rob Businesses In GTA 6
description: Yes, crime does pay in Grand Theft Auto 6, so much so that robbing businesses lets you earn quite a hefty sum. However, certain folks might not want to get pushed around, and you could find yourself running into trouble (and patrolling cops!) if you’re not careful. In This Article The rewards and pitfalls of robbing stores in Grand Theft Auto 6 NPCs that fight back Here come the cops! The rewards and pitfalls of robbing stores in Grand Theft Auto 6 You can rob businesses in GTA 6 once you have a firearm (which is pretty much within the first hour of starting the campaign). Once you have access to Jason’s home, try to explore the area to spot all sorts of small-and-medium enterprises. These include convenience stores, liquor stores, barber shops, jewelry shops, fast food restaurants/burger joints, and more. Enter the establishment, bring out your weapon, and aim at the cashier or manager. In some cases, they’ll automatically empty the cash register, netting you several hundred dollars. Here are some caveats: If the cashier is taking their sweet time, press the Threaten button prompt (Square on the PlayStation and X on the Xbox) to force their hand. Some stores have a locked safe. You can use Focus Mode by pressing both thumbsticks simultaneously to reveal the identity of the staff that has the code. You may also press the Rob button prompt (Triangle on the PlayStation and Y on the Xbox) to gain extra cash from bystanders. Note: Businesses that get robbed will temporarily close. You need to wait for a couple of in-game days to pass before they reopen. NPCs that fight back That said, your stickup shenanigans won’t always be safe and straightforward. There will be moments when NPCs fight back: Some owners and shoppers also carry guns. You might bring out a pistol, only to get a shotgun pointed at your face. Folks may heroically attempt to bring you down, and you have to mash the button prompt to pass the QTE sequence. Otherwise, you’ll get disarmed. Threatening…

title: How To Lose The Police In GTA 6
description: You’re going about your merry way in Grand Theft Auto 6, when all of a sudden, you felt the sudden urge to punch random folks, ransack some shops, and hijack a couple of vehicles. Naturally, you’ll get chased by the police, leading to action-packed moments when you try your utmost best to escape the long arm of the law. Thankfully, there are methods that allow you to sneak past patrols and even disable trackers. In This Article The police and the heat map How to change the look of your character and vehicle How to remove vehicle trackers The police and the heat map If someone witnesses you committing a crime, such as robbing businesses, the police will be called to that location. Initially, a small blue radius will appear on the map, signifying the area that cops will search. Once you’re discovered, the search radius turns red and becomes wider. This follows a tried-and-true system seen in previous games in the GTA series. It’s the concept of “heat” whereby the authorities are able to discern general information about your character, such as their look, clothing, and vehicle. For instance, Jason might be referred to as a “white male in his 30s, driving a yellow Ganado car.” These icons then appear on the heat map. How to change the look of your character and vehicle If you want to lose the police in GTA 6, you need to remain outside the search radius until your heat dissipates. This can be further impacted if you alter the appearance of your character and their vehicle: For vehicles in general, bring them over to the nearest Pay n’ Spray and purchase the Respray option. Pick any other color to throw the authorities off your tail. As for your character’s looks, you can change your outfit, including sunglasses and headwear. This is usually done by visiting Ammu-Nation or any clothing store so you can wear a different attire. You can also get a haircut or add some tattoos at a local salon or tattoo studio. title: What Happens If You Get Arrested In GTA 6
description: Getting arrested can ruin your life. In Grand Theft Auto 6, however, you can still go on and continue. That said, there’s a price to pay if you’re unable to lose the police in high-speed chases, and it might be a little too steep depending on your current progress in the game. In This Article Should you surrender or resist arrest in Grand Theft Auto 6? Penalties for getting arrested or busted in GTA 6 Should you surrender or resist arrest in Grand Theft Auto 6? You can get busted or arrested in GTA 6 if you (a) are incapacitated or (b) willingly surrender to the police. At low wanted levels, cops will generally use non-lethal means of dealing with unruly criminals--i.e. they’ll bring out tasers, stun guns, and batons instead of shotguns and sniper rifles. If you’re driving a vehicle slowly, they can also open the door and pull you down to the ground. Failing to escape and getting knocked out leads to your character's arrest. Alternatively, it’s possible to willingly surrender, too. This is done by approaching police with your weapon holstered and pressing the R1/RB button. From there, just wait for the cop to approach and handcuff you. Note: It’s also possible to mash the button prompt at this stage if you want to fight back and resist arrest. Perhaps you can still make a clean getaway. Penalties for getting arrested or busted in GTA 6 If you do get arrested in GTA 6, you’ll respawn at the last safehouse that you visited. However, you’ll also incur several penalties: You’ll lose a bit of cash on-hand and money from your BuckMe account. Any weapon that you don’t own will be lost for good. This pertains to weapons that you only looted/picked up. Weapons that you purchased and those that are stored in a stash/loadout should be safe. In most cases, the police will also recognize the vehicle that you’re driving. It will get impounded in the nearest lockup and you’ll have to hijack it. title: Does GTA 6 Have A First-Person Mode?
description: GTA 6 gives you plenty of opportunities to unleash some high-velocity lead at enemies, but like previous games in the series, that action unfolds from a third-person perspective. Is it possible to switch to first-person during these shootouts? Absolutely, but there are some limitations to take note of. How to unlock first-person shooting in GTA 6 Once you've done the opening mission in GTA 6, you'll be required to pay a visit to Ammu-Nation so that Jason can equip himself with a gun. Once you've got a piece, purchase an optics attachment. These are pretty cheap, and they're available for all weapon categories. The next time you get into a firefight, you can hit R3 on your controller, and you'll automatically enter first-person aiming. Depending on your preferences, that should make shooting a little easier for what's directly in front of you, but third-person mode does give you a wider view of your entire environment. Once you're done aiming, the action snaps back to the default third-person mode, so don't expect to be playing GTA 6 in first-person for the rest of the campaign. If you're out exploring and you don't have any weapons equipped, you can also hold down the left trigger button on your controller and press R3 to inspect the environment around you, but you are rooted in place. Not exactly your traditional first-person mode, but it's something. For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to finding a tricky location on the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered with our Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub.

title: All GTA 6 Smartphone Apps And What They Do
description: Grand Theft Auto games have regularly kept up with the times, and in GTA 6, you once again have a smartphone that you can use to interact with the world around you. From getting new missions to goofing off by wasting some in-game time on social media, the smartphone in GTA 6 is a pretty handy tool for rising up the social--and criminal--ranks of Leonida. It comes equipped with several apps, and while not every one of them is essential, you'll want to keep an eye open for certain notifications. Here's a closer look at what each app does. How to use your smartphone As a quick reminder, you can whip out your smartphone by using the Up key on the D-pad. From there, you can navigate through the apps menu using the directional keys. GTA 6 smartphone apps WAiNK The bread-and-butter app for aspiring car thieves, the WAiNK app can be used to inspect vehicles for any hidden security features. Scanning a car will let you see its estimated value, which security features it has installed, if it's locked, and how much it'll cost to register it under your name. Scooter Bros Need your personal vehicle in a hurry? A call to Scooter Bros will allow you to summon your ride to your location, so long as you don't mind the couriers stashing their little two-wheeled ride in your trunk. Whatup GTA 6's instant messaging app, this will allow you to get scoops and chat to characters, without ever needing to verbally engage with them. It's also useful for getting new missions and tips on how to make some quick cash with side-activities. Camera It's a camera. It can take selfies. What else were you expecting? Gallery Nothing too surprising here, as the Gallery app is used for checking out all the smartphone pictures you took. It also has a few archived pictures, which show off Jason and Lucia's life prior to the events that kicked off the GTA 6 storyline. Fitness Staying in shape is highly recommended in GTA 6, and this fitness app will allow you to track your gains and how your stats are…
